m: Rinse the quinoa well (it stops it tasting bitter). Simmer in double its volume of salted water for 12 minutes, then take it off the heat, cover and leave 5 minutes to steam. Fluff with a fork.
Pat the prawns dry with paper towel so they sear rather than stew. Toss with half the garlic, the sliced chilli and a pinch of salt.

Heat a splash of oil in a big frying pan over high heat. Add the broccolini and snow peas with 2 tablespoons of water, cover and steam-fry for 2 minutes. Uncover and cook 1 minute more until charred in spots. Tip out.
Add a little more oil, then the prawns in a single layer (in batches if needed). Cook 1 to 2 minutes a side until just pink and curled. Overcooked prawns go rubbery.
Toss the quinoa with the lemon zest and juice, the rest of the garlic, the chopped parsley, a drizzle of oil and salt.
Pile the greens and prawns over the lemon quinoa and crumble over the fetta.
l: Great cold. Pack the quinoa with the greens and prawns on top and the fetta separate. Eat within a day.
g: Naturally gluten free. Nothing to swap.
